name: glm-design
description: Design and frontend asset plugin bundling five skills: glm-design (HTML design task router for landing pages, portfolios and dashboards), glm-ui-ux-pro-max (UI/UX design intelligence and implementation guidance), glm-visual-design-foundations (typography, color, spacing systems and iconography), glm-web-shader-extractor (WebGL and shader effect extraction from live pages) and glm-version-management (frontend artifact version snapshots for html/jsx/tsx/vue). Trigger for visual design tasks, design-system guidance or frontend asset management. Ships a large bundled reference library.

interface.shortDescription: Five design skills: artifact routing, UI/UX intelligence, visual foundations, shader extraction and version snapshots.
interface.longDescription: GLM Design bundles the design-production stack. glm-design routes HTML artifact tasks (landing pages, portfolios, dashboards, social cards, slide decks) through the full discipline and hands version management to glm-version-management, which snapshots editable web entry files (.html/.jsx/.tsx/.vue) with parallel version control. glm-ui-ux-pro-max and glm-visual-design-foundations provide the design intelligence (typography, color, spacing systems, iconography), and glm-web-shader-extractor extracts live WebGL shader effects from real pages for reuse. Ships a large bundled reference and demo library; the router degrades gracefully when optional quality references are not loaded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-design plugin skills: <设计落地页 / UI/UX 方案 / 视觉基础 / 提取 Shader / 前端产物版本管理>
